doors.intent: Long, oversized, or complex video/audio analysis, transcription, timelines, comparison, duplicate-segment review, and LLM-consumable evidence outputs.
doors.truth_boundary: Use the live ForensiScope MCP as authority for current capabilities, pricing, ingest boundaries, rights requirements, and handoff state. Never claim media was uploaded, analyzed, paid for, or completed unless live tool state proves it.

doors.intent: Property-specific EV charging opportunity intelligence by address, including competition, demand/traffic, utility/tariff context, incentives, site fit, economics, and planning inputs.
doors.truth_boundary: Keep observed, public, licensed, inferred, and modeled evidence distinct. Preliminary site intelligence is not final engineering, surveying, permitting, utility interconnection, financing, or construction approval.

doors.intent: Free evidence-aware part identification plus paid recovery for obsolete, discontinued, obscure, ambiguous, or hard-to-source machine, vehicle, appliance, marine, industrial, construction, powersports, agricultural, electronics and equipment parts.
doors.truth_boundary: Start with the free Part Passport when identity is uncertain. A normalized identity is not fitment proof and a reachable listing is not live inventory proof. Use the live FindMyPart MCP for current offers, checkout, hunt status and evidence state. Never invent inventory, compatibility, supplier availability, price, delivery timing, payment or a successful purchase.

doors.intent: Website conversion, local SEO, performance, and practical-fix auditing.
doors.truth_boundary: Do not fabricate audit findings before the audit runs. Checkout preparation is not payment proof, and payment does not imply completed fulfillment until the product verifier confirms it.
Keep guidance user-controlled. Do not claim guaranteed hiring outcomes, employer endorsement, or access to private employer systems.

doors.intent: Event discovery, event promotion, and venue visibility.
doors.truth_boundary: Do not claim a ticket, booking, publication, promotion, payment, or venue relationship exists until the corresponding live tool state proves it. Keep publishing and commerce human-controlled.

doors.intent: Agriculture evidence briefs for water, land resilience, and production risk.
doors.truth_boundary: Preserve source provenance, uncertainty, geography, and date boundaries. Do not turn modeled or incomplete evidence into certainty.

doors.intent: Enterprise operations capability discovery, routing, migration/process pain, and privacy-preserving human handoff.
doors.truth_boundary: Do not send private customer records through public discovery. A handoff does not grant private-system access, execute business actions, create checkout, or prove deployment.

doors.intent: Public URL retrieval, structured extraction, and bounded site inspection for AI agents.
doors.truth_boundary: Public fetch and bounded site inspection are the live-verified primitives. Do not claim search, browser automation, authenticated browsing, or broader network access is live until the MCP reports those gates passed.

doors.intent: Business website planning and launch assistance.
doors.truth_boundary: Do not claim a website was purchased, deployed, published, or transferred until live tool state proves it. Paid and publishing actions remain human-confirmed.

doors.intent: Pre-decision business simulation for startup, pricing, hiring, expansion, product/service changes, acquisitions, business sales, partnerships, capital purchases and other consequential moves.
doors.truth_boundary: The resident Yard runtime is read-only modeled decision support. Pricing uses a labeled low-confidence heuristic; general scenarios perform arithmetic only on caller-supplied assumptions and do not infer market outcomes. No remote MCP is advertised until the Evercraft Compute public edge passes the external HTTPS, MCP, authority, deployment-receipt, and NodeSeed-attestation canary. No simulation authorizes real-world business action.

doors.intent: Founder capital-fit, funding-readiness, and fundraising preparation analysis.
doors.truth_boundary: Treat the output as decision support, not investment, securities, legal, tax, valuation, or fundraising-success advice. Do not imply investor interest, financing approval, or committed capital unless independently verified.

doors.intent: Read-only social-video production discovery and job planning.
doors.truth_boundary: The current MCP is read-only discovery and job planning. Do not claim video rendering, publishing, platform posting, rights clearance, payment, or distribution completion unless the live product state explicitly proves those actions occurred.

doors.intent: Low-cost text pressure tests, critique, and sharper writing feedback.
doors.truth_boundary: Checkout requires human confirmation. Checkout creation is not payment proof, and a paid result must not be claimed until provider verification confirms paid state and result availability.

doors.intent: IBM i or AS/400 estate assessment, dependency mapping, upgrade-risk review, modernization proof, and rollback/test planning.
doors.truth_boundary: Discovery does not authorize credentials, production access, upgrades, cutovers, payment, or paid work. The read-only Yard runtime is proven locally, but no remote MCP may be advertised until an independent public HTTPS route is verified.

doors.intent: App portability, vendor-lock-in, dependency, security, reconstruction, migration, and rollback analysis.
doors.truth_boundary: Source access, payment, migration work, deployment, and production changes remain separately authorized. The read-only Yard runtime is proven locally, but no remote MCP may be advertised until an independent public HTTPS route is verified.

doors.intent: Site continuity, internet-outage dependency analysis, and prioritized operational resilience planning.
doors.truth_boundary: The direct runtime does not create payment, perform the paid resilience audit, change networks, or guarantee continuity. The read-only Yard runtime is proven locally, but no remote MCP may be advertised until an independent public HTTPS route is verified.
